items.question: My husband passed away last year. Can I get the Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension?
items.answer: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS): Non‑contributory pension for widows of poor families. [nsap_ignwps--ignwps-0932bc:1:0]

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
reasons: The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-79 years. [nsap_ignwps--ignwps-0932bc:1:2]
The applicant should belong to a household living below the poverty line according to the criteria prescribed by the Govt. of India. [nsap_ignwps--ignwps-0932bc:1:2]
schemes.benefit: Non‑contributory pension for widows of poor families. [nsap_ignwps--ignwps-0932bc:1:0]
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online via UMANG or submit required documents to the local Pension Disbursement Authority. [nsap_ignwps--ignwps-0932bc:1:6]
documents: Death Certificate of husband – With the name of the surviving wife (widow). [nsap_ignwps--ignwps-0932bc:1:5]
Age Proof – birth certificate or school certificate; if absent, ration card and EPIC may be considered. [nsap_ignwps--ignwps-0932bc:1:5]
